title: Strieber's career destroyed, which he ties to the Collins Elite

tellings.quote: if you look at Beyond and the episode three and you see what happened to me and what it did to my life and it's got something to do with them. I'm convinced.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, known for his accounts of meeting non-human beings, says his career was destroyed between 1987 and the late 1990s, and he ties this to the Collins Elite, a group said to work inside the US government. He tells Michels to watch episode three of Beyond, a documentary series from MGM, to "see what happened to me and what it did to my life", adding "it's got something to do with them. I'm convinced." If true, a hidden group inside government set out to ruin a writer for what he said.
